sammendrag: This report examines two of the action research projects in the larger Wanganui Literacy and Employment project, namely 'Stepping through the looking glass: action research at Training for You' and 'Family learning at Castlecliff School in Wanganui'. It examines the outcomes of cycle two of each program and the future of each project.
tittel: Action research reflections: The Wanganui adult literacy and employment project
